NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE CORP. LTD. 
 
 CIN U45201WB2005PLC904417 · GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1 · Salt Lake, Kolkata
 
 PROJECT COMPLETION CERTIFICATE 
 
 Issued by the Contractor 
 
 Ref: NICL/CC/117/31/0 Date: 31/03/2026 
 
 1. PROJECT PARTICULARS 
 The following table records the particulars of the work certified below, 
 reconciled against the underlying vouchers before issue. 
 
 Project Name Hydro Tunnel - Jharkhand Pkg-117 
 
 Client Arunodaya Infrastructure (Private) 
 Scope of Work Tunnels works for Arunodaya Infrastructure 
 completed 2022. 
 
 Work Category Tunnels 
 
 Contract Value Rs. 47.41 Crore 
 Completion Date 2022-03-19 
 
 Project Manager Meera Roy 
 
 2. DECLARATION OF COMPLETION 
 
 The work was executed under site conditions that included restricted access
 requiring night-time material movement. The work was inspected in stages, with
 each stage recorded in the measurement book, and the client's representative
 assessed the completed work as Good. 
 We, National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd., the undersigned contractor, hereby
 certify that the above-mentioned project has been completed in all respects in
 
 accordance with the contract terms, approved drawings, technical specifications,
 and applicable Indian Standards (IS codes). 
 The work has been executed under the supervision of our project management team
 and has been found satisfactory during all interim inspections conducted by the
 client's authorized representatives. 
 
 3. COMPLIANCE SUMMARY 
 
 PARAMETER STATUS 
 
 Scope Completion 100% - All deliverables completed 
 
 Quality Standards Compliant with IS codes and contract specifications 
 Safety Compliance BOCW Act provisions followed; zero LTI 
 
 EIA conditions adhered to

 5. DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD 
 
 During the period stated the contractor shall make good, at its own cost, any
 defect attributable to workmanship or materials that comes to notice. Retention
 money is released on expiry of that period once the client is satisfied no such
 defect remains outstanding. 
 
 The defect liability period of 365 days from the date of completion (i.e., until
 2023-03-19) remains in force. Any defects observed during this period shall be
 rectified at our cost without additional charge to the client. 
 We request the client to kindly issue the final completion certificate and
 
 release the retention money as per the contract terms. 
 FOR AUTHORISED USE ONLY 
 
 
 
 Meera Roy Director (Projects) 
 Project Manager National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
